- Maximise the game's production score at 0:20:00 (ore/coal/stone ~3 pts, plate ~6, crafted items more; wood worth 0). Previous player scored 18,617 with 15 drill+furnace pairs and late hand-crafting. Beat that by building pairs much earlier and keeping the hand-craft queue busy all game.
